title: Smarter early ranking
reader_summary: Tune how we rank Skills repos when 7-day star history is thin, so bootstrap weeks look less noisy.
how_we_measure: Primary: ranking stability (day-over-day overlap of top 10 during bootstrap-like periods), fewer obvious junk/mega-repo swings. Use digest.json; PostHog secondary.
hypothesis: Tightening bootstrap / max-stars guards improves list quality and day-over-day stability without hiding real momentum picks.
change_summary: Tune ranking bootstrap knobs on both digests (DIGEST_SKILLS_MAX_STARS_BOOTSTRAP for Skills, DIGEST_MAX_STARS_BOOTSTRAP for OSS, and related filters). Exact values fixed at treatment start after baseline review; OSS value set separately from its own baseline.
notes: Queued #5. Product backlog RANK-1. Placeholder bootstrap cap 20000 (production default today 25000 in .env.example); confirm tighter/looser value after baseline digest.json review at treatment start. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260913-rank-bootstrap-skills.md. 2026-09-26: extended to run on both OSS and Skills digests per Brian (id keeps its -skills suffix for continuity).
